theorem: The arithmetic generators close to SL3(Z), but their first canonical finite bridges to the minimum shell occur only after passing to parabolic S4 quotients: the mod-2 point parabolic is S4, the mod-3 Levi has projective quotient PGL2(3)=S4, and the residual-duad stabilizer S2 x S4 has the same S4 quotient.
